title: X Player Bridge
name: x_player_bridge
short_description: Reference showcase demonstrating how to integrate mods with x_player_api's dual-format models (3d_armor, skinsdb, shields, wieldview, and more).
long_description:
A showcase integration bridge and reference implementation demonstrating how to leverage `x_player_api`'s dual-model visual architecture (`.glb` multi-track and `.b3d` single-timeline fallbacks) to easily adapt various popular equipment, skin, weapon, locomotion, and social mods in Luanti.

> **Note**: The primary goal of `x_player_bridge` is not to permanently cover and inherit compatibility across all possible mods in the ecosystem. Rather, it serves as an open reference showcase illustrating how other mod authors can implement direct `x_player_api` support and compatibility natively within their own mods.

## Features

- **Modular Registry**: Extensible module lifecycle system with automatic mod detection, dependency sorting, and granular configuration toggles.
- **3D Armor Integration (`3d_armor`)**: Bundles `3d_armor_character.glb` and `3d_armor_character.b3d` with full armor UV layout support. Automatically synchronizes composited armor texture layers and helmet/chest/leggings/boots visuals across dual visual proxy entities while preserving multi-track glTF animations.
- **Locked-Foot Bow Animation**: `3d_armor_character.glb` features an athletic courtly bow animation where the upper torso bends respectfully while the feet stay firmly planted on the ground without sliding.
- **Shields Integration (`shields`)**: Bridges shield equip events and active blocking guard postures (`block`) into `x_player_api`'s action layer when defending against incoming attacks.
- **Wieldview & 3D Wield Items (`wieldview`, `wield3d`, `visible_wielditem`)**: Dynamically toggles 2D hand texture compositing and suppresses redundant external 3D wield entities to eliminate z-fighting and duplicate rendered items when `x_player_api`'s native 3D wield items are active.
- **Skins & Appearance (`skinsdb`, `simple_skins`, `clothing`)**: Provides transparent model redirection and automatic texture synchronization across dual visual proxies for skinsdb, simple_skins, and clothing layers.
- **Combat & Weapons (`bows`)**: Seamlessly binds external bow drawing and shooting states to `x_player_api`'s `bow_aim` and `bow_shoot` action animations.
- **Locomotion & Movement (`stamina`, `hangglider`, `3d_armor_flyswim`)**: Automatically reflects stamina sprinting states, gliding flight poses with rotation pitch, and swim/crawl posture compatibility.
- **Social Interactions (`emote`)**: Maps chat and gesture emote triggers directly to high-fidelity glTF gesture tracks.
- **Modular & Granular Toggles**: Every integration module can be individually enabled or disabled via `settingtypes.txt` or `luanti.conf`.
